requirements: explicit change to this baseline file

baseline_expansion_policy.resolved_failure_policy: Remove fixed nodes from this baseline in the same PR that fixes them, or create a tightly scoped baseline-reduction follow-up.

baseline_count_adjustments.rationale: PR #121 adds one authenticated support feedback intake live proof that calls a deployed API and must be deselected from the non-live CI run. No new failing or erroring test node is accepted by this count-only adjustment.

PR #187 adds five Horse Passport transfer workflow tests that call a running deployed API through requests and Mongo. They remain collected as live tests and are deselected from the non-live CI run. No new failing or erroring test node is accepted by this count-only adjustment.
